title: Detailed envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='envGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f5e6c8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8d4a8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='flapGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff2d9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0ddb8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='innerGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d4b888'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c4a878'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stampGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e04545'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sealGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4466'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc2244'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Envelope body -->
  <rect x='12' y='32' width='76' height='52' rx='3' ry='3' fill='url(#envGrad)' stroke='#d4b888' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Shadow under flap -->
  <polygon points='12,32 50,60 88,32' fill='#c4a878' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Back inner area (visible under flap) -->
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='72' height='48' rx='2' ry='2' fill='url(#innerGrad)'/>

  <!-- Flap folded down -->
  <polygon points='12,32 50,62 88,32' fill='url(#flapGrad)' stroke='#d4b888' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Flap highlight line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='32' stroke='#e8d4a8' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Left side crease -->
  <line x1='12' y1='32' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#d4b888' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Right side crease -->
  <line x1='88' y1='32' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#d4b888' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Bottom edges -->
  <line x1='14' y1='84' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#d4b888' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
  <line x1='86' y1='84' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#d4b888' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Stamp -->
  <rect x='68' y='38' width='16' height='18' rx='1.5' ry='1.5' fill='url(#stampGrad)' stroke='#cc3333' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Stamp perforations (dots) -->
  <circle cx='69' cy='39' r='0.8' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='39' r='0.8' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='55' r='0.8' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='55' r='0.8' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='39' r='0.8' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='55' r='0.8' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <!-- Stamp inner design - little star -->
  <polygon points='76,42 77.5,46 82,46 78.5,48.5 79.5,53 76,50 72.5,53 73.5,48.5 70,46 74.5,46' fill='#ffeebb' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Address lines -->
  <line x1='20' y1='66' x2='48' y2='66' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='72' x2='44' y2='72' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='78' x2='40' y2='78' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Wax seal -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='6' fill='url(#sealGrad)' stroke='#aa1133' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#ff6688' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Seal shine -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#ff99aa' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Return address corner -->
  <line x1='18' y1='37' x2='34' y2='37' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='40' x2='30' y2='40' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Envelope edge highlights -->
  <line x1='13' y1='33' x2='13' y2='83' stroke='#fff8ea' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.4'/>
  <line x1='87' y1='33' x2='87' y2='83' stroke='#fff8ea' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.3'/>
</svg>
